issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] I checked the documentation and found no answer; - [x] I checked to make sure that this issue has not already been filed; - [x] This is not an ad/bug report. ### Problem description In the Japanese version of AdGuard for Android, 'Apps' is translated as 'VPN対象外アプリ,' which means 'apps excluded from VPN.' ### Proposed solution "Apps" should simply be translated as "アプリ" (or "アプリ別" to convey "by app"). The current translation "VPN対象外アプリ" is incorrect — it actually means "apps excluded from VPN," which is a completely different meaning and has nothing to do with this section, which just shows a per-app breakdown of blocked ads/trackers. ### Additional information I think everything went smoothly up to 4.1.2.3.
